The '''SFS I-s3a solar ionization reactor''' was a model of [[Solar ionization reactor/Legends|solar ionization reactor]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. It was the primary power [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] for several classes of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]], including the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]],<ref name="EGVV" /> the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]],<ref name="SC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref> and the [[TIE/ad starfighter]].<ref name="Avenger">{{DB|starship|tieavenger|TIE avenger}}</ref>
